description: Officially designated evacuation destinations curated with citations for app/backend/api/dispatch_area.py (dispatch-area/6). Coordinates [lon, lat] WGS84 as lon/lat fields. capacity is people and only set when a source publishes it; otherwise the builder applies its labelled per-kind assumption. The City of Berkeley publishes no list of temporary evacuation points (its Evacuation StoryMaps text, July 2025, says shelters open in safe areas per incident, possibly outside Berkeley); its 'Shelter Sites' layer is used instead.

sources.title: City of Berkeley Shelter Sites (ShelterSites_WFL1)
sources.notes: Item page: https://www.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=8ce24effc8734e819eb2b738b2885390. Public, created 2024-01-25, last modified 2026-06-29 (UTC). 13 points; fields only OBJECTID, Name, Address (no capacity, no type, no description). The layer does not state whether these are evacuation/care-and-shelter sites or another shelter use; no berkeleyca.gov page linking it was found. Published by the same City account as its evacuation StoryMaps.

sources.title: Evacuation StoryMaps, Text-Only Version (July 2025)
sources.notes: Context only: no temporary evacuation point list is published.

excludeListings.reason: FEMA NSS record for MLK Jr. Middle School (1781 Rose St) is placed about 3.3 km south of the school; the City point (matching Nominatim way/54582535) is used, with this record's evacuation_capacity 500.
